title: A Local Linking Theorem for Relativistic Action Functionals
summary: We establish an analogue of the Brezis-Nirenberg local linking theorem for a class of Szulkin-type functionals arising from relativistic action principles. In this framework, compactness of Palais-Smale sequences is formulated with respect to a topology induced by the effective domain of the functional, replacing the classical strong Palais-Smale condition. The proof combines the original construction of the min-max geometry, based on a negative gradient flow, with the Ekeland-Lasry regularization.
